messages:
morgan: Quick sync 12 I ran a pass across API gateway, auth, console, billing, and runtime for audit-event coverage gaps. Found fallthroughs where customer-facing evidence will fail during compliance review. Need triage and owners.

sam: list the high-priority missing events pls

morgan: API gateway: missing 403/ratelimit rejection events with client metadata (client_cert_subject, client_app_id). Auth: token_refresh and service-account key rotations missing rotation_reason and ip. Console: account-settings change, admin_impersonation, and 2FA recovery token usage. Billing: invoice_download (we capture view but not download) and billing-key-view (PII boundary). Runtime: model-deploy config changes, model-rollbacks, and fallback-to-legacy-model events.

alina: KMS note: KMS rotations currently log only key_id for some services. Customers require key provenance (key_id + rotation_reason + previous_key_id). Also RBAC change events should include before/after role bundles and who-initiated.

sam: agreed on RBAC diffs. propose token_refresh event sample: 

```json
{
  "event_type": "token.refresh",
  "actor_id": "user:1234",
  "client_ip": "3.4.5.6",
  "outcome": "success",
  "method": "refresh_token",
  "schema_version": "v2",
  "meta": {"old_token_id": "t-abc", "new_token_id": "t-def"}
}
```

sam: schema_version bump so we can add actor_device and key_id in v3 later.

kai: ran grep across repos: api-gw missing client_cert_subject; auth-service misses rotation_reason; console lacks admin_impersonation and account_settings.change events; billing logs view but not download; runtime emits deploy but not rollback/fallback reasons.

morgan: For customer-facing validation we must:
- ensure schema compatibility and provide a migration guide
- offer opt-in richer audit stream (client_geo, key_arn) behind feature flag
- add sampling vs full-evidence modes for enterprise with retention options

jordan: who picks backlog items? I can take API gateway + console. will open tickets and loop QA.

morgan: assign api-gw -> @jordan, auth -> @alina, billing -> @sam, runtime -> @kai. I'll coordinate rollout & cust comms.

auditeer-bot: sample event emitted for validation: {event_type: audit.sample, svc: api-gateway, id: e-20240315-01, status: emitted}

alina: KMS integration question: log full KMS ARN or hashed key id? auditors want ARN but storing full ARN increases sensitivity. suggestion: store full ARN in long-term secure store, hash in default stream; provide audit export with ARN on request.

sam: add key_identifier type enum {arn,kid_hash} and an access_level tag to control exposure.

kai: triage proposal: central matrix doc (service x event_type) with cols: current_coverage(Y/partial/N), missing_fields, owner, ETA, customer-impact. Use matrix to bulk-create Jira tickets prioritized by compliance/regulatory impact.

morgan: creating matrix template now. sample csv line:

```csv
service,event_type,current_coverage,missing_fields,owner,priority,notes
api-gateway,request.blocked,partial,client_cert_subject;client_app_id,jordan,P1,required for 3rd-party audit evidence
```

morgan: action items:
- jordan: open API gateway + console tickets (ETA 48h)
- alina: spec KMS/role-diff schema additions + retention implications (ETA 72h)
- sam: submit token_refresh schema PR & validators (ETA 48h)
- kai: produce matrix + grep output attachment (ETA 24h)
- morgan: draft customer comms + enterprise feature-flag plan (ETA 72h)

jordan: on it, will ping when tickets are live

sam: starting draft schema PR at infra/audit-schemas, will tag eng-security for review

morgan: also need a small automated validation CLI to replay customer events to a sandbox for validation. jordan + sam, coordinate after tickets created.

jordan: yep will coordinate with sam

morgan: final note: keep default schema conservative (avoid PII fields) but ensure toggle to emit richer fields for enterprise with consent. checkpoint 72h :calendar:
